title: 第六章 突破！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“啧…可惜了。”

秦师傅摇头，看向杨旭，“杨总，看来您这次打眼了，不过翡翠这行就这样，打眼很正常。”

“呵…呵呵，秦师傅说的是。”

杨旭干笑，陈若彤笑容满面，“秦师傅，麻烦您了，您去休息吧。”

秦师傅应声，转身离开。

杨旭脸色僵硬，看向陈若彤。

“呵呵，杨旭，怎么说？”

“这有什么好说的？我愿赌服输就是。”杨旭很痛快，拿出手机。

“等等。”陈若彤说了句，看向叶凡，“小凡，你把你的银行卡号说一下吧，让杨总把钱转给你，毕竟这是你赢的么。”

“嗯？这…”

“怎么了？”

陈若彤美眸一闪，挽住叶凡手臂，“你不是说想给我买几件礼物么？这钱正好。”

叶凡心中一动，他看见了杨旭眼中的阴沉。

瞬间他明白过来。

“靠，我说陈若彤怎么变化这么大，这杨旭明显想追求她，但她不喜欢杨旭，所以她这是把我当挡箭牌了！”

心中暗骂，叶凡说出自己卡号，他清楚，陈若彤是他老板，他不能拆老板的台。

很快，一百万到账，叶凡道，“谢谢杨总。”

“呵…呵呵，别客气。”

杨旭干笑，“兄弟眼力惊人，我很佩服，以后咱们多交流。”

“只要赵总吩咐，随叫随到。”叶凡应声。

“好。”

杨旭应声，转身离开。

见到对方离开，陈若彤长出口气，松开叶凡。

“叶凡，刚才抱歉了，你别介意。”

抱歉有毛用，人我都得罪完了！

心中暗骂，叶凡面上微笑，“陈总客气，为老板做事是应该的。”

“呵呵，好。”

陈若彤一笑，很满意叶凡态度，“接下来你可以回家休息了，你之前选的原石，我会评估价值，然后我会按照分成给你，以后你也不用天天来店，以你的眼力，只需在关键时刻来店，帮忙鉴定就好。”

“好的陈总。”叶凡应声。

陈若彤向远方一招手。

一个穿西装的中年人走过来。

“何叔，接下来就由你送叶凡回去，顺便再去杨家一趟，说明他和我们盛宝楼的关系。”

Page (1/3)

"Tsk...what a pity."

Master Qin shook his head and looked at Yang Xu, "Mr. Yang, it seems that you got a piercing this time, but this is how it is in the jade industry, and piercing is normal."

"Haha...haha, that's what Master Qin said."

Yang Xu laughed dryly, and Chen Ruotong smiled broadly, "Master Qin, please go and rest."

Master Qin responded, turned and left.

Yang Xu's face was stiff and he looked at Chen Ruotong.

"Haha, Yang Xu, what do you say?"

"What's there to say? I'm willing to admit defeat." Yang Xu happily took out his mobile phone.

"Wait a minute." Chen Ruotong said and looked at Ye Fan, "Xiaofan, please tell me your bank card number and let Mr. Yang transfer the money to you. After all, you won this."

"Huh? This..."

"What's wrong?"

Chen Ruotong's beautiful eyes flashed, and she took Ye Fan's arm, "Didn't you say you wanted to buy me some gifts? The money is just right."

Ye Fan's heart moved, and he saw the gloom in Yang Xu's eyes.

He understood instantly.

"Damn, why did Chen Ruotong change so much? Yang Xu obviously wants to pursue her, but she doesn't like Yang Xu, so she is using me as a shield!"

Cursing secretly in his heart, Ye Fan revealed his card number. He knew that Chen Ruotong was his boss and he could not undermine his boss.

Soon, one million arrived, and Ye Fan said, "Thank you, Mr. Yang."

"Hehe...hehe, you're welcome."

Yang Xu smiled dryly, "Brother, I admire you for your amazing eyesight. Let's communicate more in the future."

"As long as Mr. Zhao orders me, I'll be there at your call." Ye Fan responded.

"Okay."

Yang Xu responded, turned and left.

Seeing the other party leaving, Chen Ruotong let out a long sigh and let go of Ye Fan.

"Ye Fan, I'm sorry just now, don't mind."

Sorry, it's useless, I've offended everyone!

Cursing secretly in his heart, Ye Fan smiled on his face and said, "Mr. Chen, you are polite, you should do things for the boss."

"Haha, okay."

Chen Ruotong smiled, very satisfied with Ye Fan's attitude, "You can go home and rest now. I will evaluate the value of the rough stone you chose before, and then I will give it to you according to the share. In the future, you don't have to come to the store every day. With your eyesight, you only need to come to the store at critical moments to help appraise it."

"Okay Mr. Chen." Ye Fan responded.

Chen Ruotong waved to the distance.

A middle-aged man in a suit came over.

"Uncle He, it's up to you to send Ye Fan back, and by the way, go to Yang's house to explain his relationship with our Shengbao Tower."
